body.title: Releases with downloadable assets
body.body:
We publish our open-source CLI with goreleaser. On every tag it creates a release and uploads the binaries and a checksums file.

What we need:
 - Releases tied to tags, with notes, and a release page in the UI.
 - An API for creating a release and uploading assets. If it follows GitHub's Releases API, goreleaser works unchanged through its github_urls setting.
 - Stable download URLs for assets.

body.title: Webhooks for push, tag and pull request events
body.body:
We'd like to run CI (Woodpecker) and automatic deploys from Pushin repositories. Both learn about changes from forge webhooks, so without them a push or a tag builds nothing.

What we need:
 - Per-repository webhooks, configurable in the UI and the API.
 - Events: push (with branch and before/after SHA), tag created, and pull request opened, updated or closed.
 - Payloads in the GitHub or Gitea shape, since the API already follows GitHub.
 - A signature header (HMAC-SHA256 with a shared secret).
 - A delivery log with redelivery, so a missed delivery can be seen and fixed.

Thanks for the nice product!
